title: A Communication Complexity Lower Bound for Nonuniformly Convex Consensus Optimization
summary: We study the communication complexity of convex decentralized optimization over time-varying networks, where $n$ nodes hold private functions and must agree on the global minimizer using only synchronous exchanges with neighbors. The cost is the number of communication rounds to reach accuracy $\varepsilon$ -- a measure akin to round complexity in the LOCAL model, but constrained by nodes sharing only oracle responses.
